### test_commands.das

The command registry: invocation, logical chords, binding persistence and conflicts, and chords under the macOS input model.

- `test_command_invocation_is_input_source_agnostic` - an enabled command accepts and queues a menu invocation under its semantic ID, and a disabled one rejects every invocation source
- `test_command_chords_speak_logical_ctrl` - command_binding_chord puts a primary binding on the logical Ctrl bit and a secondary one on the logical Super bit on every platform
- `test_command_bindings_save_load_and_conflict_roundtrip` - bindings report a same-scope chord conflict, round-trip an edited chord through an explicit config file, and keep an explicitly cleared binding across save and load
- `test_command_alt_only_binding_reports_its_conflict` - a binding with only a second chord has no primary, yet it and the command it collides with each report the conflict, and an alt-only default binding registers
- `test_command_load_keeps_defaults_for_absent_alt_chord` - a config written before second chords existed loads with its saved primary and the default second chord kept, while a saved second chord still overrides the default
- `test_macos_chords` - under forced macOS behaviors bindings and synth chords speak logical Ctrl: Ctrl+K and Super+J fire their commands and capture files a held Ctrl as the primary modifier

### test_document_model.das

- `test_document_source_roundtrip_preserves_bom_and_line_endings` - installing UTF-8 bytes keeps the BOM as metadata outside the parser text, and an unedited save returns the original bytes exactly with mixed line endings and a clean dirty flag
- `test_document_edit_is_revision_checked_and_exactly_invertible` - an edit applies only at its base revision, so a stale replay is rejected with the bytes untouched, and its recorded inverse restores the original text exactly
- `test_document_edit_maps_source_anchors` - positions and range ends after an edit shift by its byte delta while those before it stay anchored

### test_glfw_synth.das

GLFW-side synthetic keyboard and mouse driver - end-to-end gates. The driver in `modules/dasGlfw/dasglfw/glfw_live.das` posts events through dasGLFW's C++ chain dispatcher, which delivers them to the ImGui_ImplGlfw callbacks, so ImGui sees them as real input.

- `test_key_press_release_held_count` - a synth Shift press raises key_status.held_count to at least 1 and its release brings it back to 0

- `test_key_play_event_list_completes` - a hand-built key_play press-char-release timeline runs to completion with no key left held
- `test_key_stop_aborts` - key_stop ends a long key_type mid-flight, reporting stopped and clearing playing
- `test_key_stop_releases_held_modifiers` - key_stop releases a synth-held Ctrl that had no paired release, reporting released=1 and dropping held_count to 0

- `test_key_hud_signals_reachable` - the held-keys count and last-codepoint signals the keycap HUD paints from respond to a synth Shift press and a key_type
- `test_mouse_pos_lands_in_status` - mouse_pos sets the daslang-side cursor that mouse_status reports to the exact coordinates
- `test_mouse_buttons_io_mirror` - a synth button press and release reach ImGui's event-driven io.mouse_buttons[0]
- `test_mouse_move_to_animates` - mouse_move_to passes through mid-flight positions and lands on its endpoint when playback ends
- `test_mouse_play_event_list_completes` - a hand-built mouse_play timeline of moves, a scroll and a click runs to completion and leaves the cursor on its last move
- `test_mouse_stop_aborts` - mouse_stop ends a long mouse_move_to mid-flight, reporting stopped and clearing playing
- `test_synth_cursor_ownership_sticky` - any synth mouse event makes cursor_owned true, and it stays true after a mouse_play timeline drains
- `test_mouse_stop_releases_held_buttons` - mouse_stop releases a synth-pressed button, reporting released=1 and clearing both held_count and io.mouse_buttons[0]

### test_markdown.das

Markdown viewer: bindings, code-block reports, interaction.

- `test_markdown_host_image_binding_lifecycle` - a host image binding is keyed by document revision and node, rejects a zero texture, ignores an identical rebind, and a new resource revision or an unbind invalidates the image layout
- `test_markdown_syntax_binding_lifecycle` - syntax token snapshots bind per document revision and code node, reject negative keys, and only a real bind, unbind or clear moves the syntax layout revision
- `test_markdown_code_blocks_before_first_layout` - a parsed but never drawn document still reports its code block, marked unlaid-out with no icon rects and zero geometry
- `test_markdown_code_blocks_shorter_cache` - a document that outgrew the node cache still reports every code block with its node index, the ones past the cache unlaid-out
- `test_markdown_code_blocks_report_layout` - a laid-out code block reports its collapsed state, screen origin and the midpoints of its fold and copy icon rects
- `test_markdown_view_event_driven_interactions` - every Markdown viewer input - hover, drag-select, copy, context menu, caret keys, wheel - is acknowledged in the live app's state, and typography scales, table alignment, image layout and code metadata reach the renderer

### test_markdown_hybrid_model.das

Pure-logic coverage for the live-preview segmentation: no UI, no live host.

- `test_hybrid_line_starts` - line starts give one entry per newline plus a trailing empty line, and an empty source is one line
- `test_hybrid_two_paragraphs` - each paragraph unfolds as its own source island, the separating blank and trailing lines attach to the preceding block, and a caret on the blank unfolds that block
- `test_hybrid_segment_order` - a caret in a code block splits the document into a rich run, the source island naming the excluded node, and a rich run resuming after it, in source order
- `test_hybrid_fenced_code_covers_fences` - a fenced code island covers the opening fence, the closing fence and its blank, and a caret on the closing fence keeps the same island
- `test_hybrid_fence_at_eof_without_closer` - an unclosed fence's island starts at the fence and runs to the end of the document
- `test_hybrid_thematic_breaks` - each thematic break owns its marker line and the following blank, so consecutive breaks and the closing paragraph resolve to separate islands
- `test_hybrid_setext_underline` - a setext underline belongs to its heading's island, which reaches the start of the body
- `test_hybrid_nested_list_items` - a caret on a list item unfolds that item alone at its own nesting level, while a caret on the parent's head unfolds the parent with its nested subtree
- `test_hybrid_item_with_code_block` - a caret in a list item's code block unfolds just the fenced block without the marker line, while a caret on the item head unfolds the whole item
- `test_hybrid_quote_inner_paragraph` - a block quote unfolds one inner paragraph at a time, excluding the inner paragraph node rather than the quote
- `test_hybrid_edges` - an empty document is one source segment, leading blanks attach to the first block, and a single block owns the whole buffer

### test_markdown_model.das

- `test_non_markdown_producer_uses_shared_rich_document` - a non-Markdown producer builds the same shared rich document and block tree, and Markdown-looking bytes gain no Markdown semantics without the Markdown adapter
- `test_empty_source_inline_content_keeps_its_run` - an empty plain source is a valid rich document whose URI splitting keeps its single run at the source head with no display bytes
- `test_tight_list_direct_inline_content` - a tight list item's direct inline content keeps its text and its strong and regular runs and excludes the nested list
- `test_markdown_gfm_model` - a GFM document parses into typed nodes with exact UTF-8 leaf ranges, decoded entities, styled and linked inline runs, autolinks, task markers, table metadata and fenced code, with raw HTML disabled by default
- `test_markdown_checkbox_projects_to_revision_checked_source_edit` - a task checkbox becomes a toggle control with an exact source mapping whose event yields a lowercase-x edit guarding the original byte, and a stale event is rejected before any source mutation
- `test_markdown_options` - restricted Markdown options still parse, and the strikethrough and table extensions can each be disabled
- `test_markdown_rejects_invalid_utf8` - invalid UTF-8 is rejected before native parsing with a stable diagnostic
- `test_markdown_plain_unicode_uris` - plain Unicode and custom-scheme URIs in Markdown become semantic links mapped to exact source without fabricating a Markdown node
- `test_markdown_image_is_atomic_with_plain_text_fallback` - an image is one atomic inline run that displays its alt text as fallback, keeps destination, title, accessible alt and link activation, and claims no Markdown syntax range it lacks
- `test_markdown_selection_source_and_styles` - a display selection maps to the original Markdown content bytes and reports its semantic styles: one combination, all regular, or mixed across styles
- `test_markdown_selection_rich_export` - a rich selection exports as plain display text, standalone Markdown syntax, escaped HTML with styles, links and images, and a URI list naming each destination once

### test_rich_das_model.das

Pure-logic coverage for the rich-das provider: classification, grouping, fragment stripping, caret mapping, and the adoption cache.

- `test_rich_das_classification` - rich-das classifies // lines, indented // lines and block-comment interiors as full comments, code with a trailing comment as code, and nothing in a non-daslang buffer as rich
- `test_rich_das_grouping` - comment lines group by adjacency, with a blank line or an indent change starting a new group and a self-contained block comment forming its own
- `test_rich_das_block_comment_poisoning` - a block comment whose opener or closer shares a line with code, or which holds a blank interior line, forms no rich group
- `test_rich_das_fragment_strip` - a group's Markdown fragment strips the indent, the comment prefix and exactly one space per line, records the stripped bytes, and keeps block-comment interiors and indented code intact
- `test_rich_das_caret_mapping` - a caret in a rendered fragment maps back to the exact source line, with the stripped head bytes added back to the column
- `test_rich_das_adoption_cache` - rich-das sync reparses only what changed: nothing at the same revision, one group for an edit inside it, nothing for a code edit between groups, and only a new comment group when one appears

### test_scroll_focus.das

Scroll and keyboard focus, captured and driven from code.

- `test_scroll_state_smoke` - An overflowing window and an overflowing child each report a non-zero scroll_max.y and a float2 scroll in their snapshot payloads.
- `test_scroll_here_y_smoke` - A child opens scrolled to the top, set_scroll_here_y(0.5) after row 100 scrolls it past 1000 pixels, and the jump-to-top button brings it back to 0.
- `test_child_scroll_reenter_moves_scroll` - SetScrollY inside child_scroll_reenter moves the original child's observed scroll, so the wrapper re-enters the same child ID, not a phantom sibling.
- `test_focus_control_smoke` - Clicking a refocus button routes keyboard focus through set_keyboard_focus_here to the input after it, and the other button routes it back.
- `test_imgui_focus_keyboard` - imgui_focus on an input answers ok and gives it keyboard focus on a later frame, while a display-only widget refuses focus with an error.

### test_snapshot.das

The live snapshot: what the registry reports and under which path, who owns the payloads, bbox transforms, and the wait family's timeout dump.

- `test_one_snapshot` - a single imgui_snapshot roundtrip over POST /command returns the triggers app's registry with MAIN_WIN/SAVE_BTN in it
- `test_snapshot_transfers_payload_ownership` - imgui_snapshot moves each widget's serialized payload into the returned JSON, leaving the registry entry no pointer to it
- `test_snapshot_transform` - under a pushed snapshot item transform a button and a tab header report bbox = canvas_bbox * scale + offset, and widgets before the push and after the pop carry no canvas_bbox
- `test_unrendered_widget_visible` - a widget whose render path never runs still appears in the snapshot through its init registration, with rendered false and a readable payload, beside a rendered one with a bbox
- `test_id_override` - with_id scopes and per-call id= and path= overrides shape each widget's snapshot path and diverge its ImGui hex_id, and an id= literal never becomes a path segment
- `test_auto_dump_on_timeout` - auto-dump on wait timeout defaults to on and toggles, and a wait for an absent widget returns null on timeout
- `test_log_to_text_smoke` - a button firing log_to_clipboard, log_text and log_finish back to back counts its click and leaves the surrounding widgets registered
- `test_output_text_smoke` - text_show keeps a source-initialized value pinned, picks up a daslang-side write to a display-only value, and round-trips imgui_force_set

### test_style_scopes.das

Style, font and item-flag scopes, and theme scaling.

- `test_with_style_smoke` - Buttons inside single and nested with_style blocks and after them all register, so the style pushes balance, and the styled buttons still count clicks.
- `test_disabled_block_smoke` - Widgets inside and after a with_disabled block all register whatever the disabled gate says.
- `test_font_stack_smoke` - The text and button inside a with_font block render.
- `test_dynamic_font_scale_smoke` - Text rows drawn under with_font at 16, 24 and 32 pixels report strictly taller bboxes, so the per-push size reaches PushFont.
- `test_button_repeat_smoke` - Buttons inside and after a with_button_repeat block register, the one after it with no clicks counted.
- `test_with_tab_stop_smoke` - The with_tab_stop demo renders its window and the field wrapped in the no-tab-stop block.
- `test_apply_daslang_theme_base_constants` - apply_daslang_theme sets the documented 1x paddings, spacings, roundings and sizes.
- `test_scale_all_sizes_doubles_at_2x` - ScaleAllSizes(2) on the daslang theme doubles paddings, spacings, roundings and sizes and leaves border widths at 1.

### test_synth_io.das

Synthetic input below the GLFW backend: the ImGui-bypass key and mouse event queue, the playwright drag and type_text helpers built on it, the io mirror, and chord naming.

- `test_key_range_markers_are_not_nameable` - imgui_key_is_nameable refuses ImGuiKey's three range markers, which ImGui's GetKeyName asserts on
- `test_real_keys_and_single_mods_are_nameable` - imgui_key_is_nameable admits None, real keys, the NamedKey_BEGIN alias of Tab and single modifiers
- `test_enum_walk_admits_only_nameable_values` - walking the whole ImGuiKey enum the way imgui_key_chord does refuses exactly three values, all outside the named-key range
- `test_imgui_synth_ctrl_shortcuts` - after a synth click into an InputText the ImGui-bypass driver still routes Ctrl shortcuts: typed text lands, a held synth Ctrl shows in io, and Ctrl+A then Backspace empties the buffer
- `test_imgui_synth_keys_smoke` - imgui_focus plus imgui_key_type, bypassing GLFW, type Hello into an initially empty focused input
- `test_imgui_synth_mouse_smoke` - raw imgui_mouse_pos and imgui_mouse_click events at a button's bbox center raise its click_count from 0 to 1
- `test_io_mirror_smoke` - the snapshot carries a top-level io object whose mouse_pos has x and y and whose three mouse_buttons read false while idle
- `test_imgui_drag_value_changes` - drag rejects an unknown target, echoes a known one, and its synth press-move-release timeline moves the slider off 0
- `test_imgui_type_text_buffer_fills` - type_text rejects empty text, echoes its target, fills the input with hello, and a newline in the stream inserts exactly one newline in a multiline buffer
- `test_multiline_shift_enter_inserts_newline` - Shift+Enter and Shift+KeypadEnter each insert one newline in an active multiline editor

### test_tables.das

data_table: cells, headers, background tints, sort specs.

- `test_data_table_smoke` - data_table registers its kind with all 24 cells at container-nested paths, cell text reads back as authored, and the columns order left to right.
- `test_table_custom_headers_smoke` - Tables with manual table_header cells and with an angled headers row both register as data_table with every body cell and its authored text.
- `test_table_set_bg_color_smoke` - Per-row and per-cell table_set_bg_color calls leave the table's 32 cells registered with their values, the tinted branches included.
- `test_sort_specs_table_renders` - A sortable data_table with a sort_specs block renders its rows and the text after the table.

### test_tabs.das

Tab bars: tab buttons, selection from automation, wrapping.

- `test_tab_item_button_smoke` - tab_item_button widgets register their kind and count clicks, and the ADD_TAB click grows the indexed tab list while HELP adds no tab.
- `test_tab_select_smoke` - imgui_select on a tab flips its snapshot-visible selected flag on, the previous tab's off, and stops the previous tab's body painting.
- `test_wrap_tab_bar` - The wrapping tab bar starts on tab 0 with only its body painted, and a force_set index switches both the value and the painted body.
- `test_wrap_tab_bar_click_by_name` - Each wrapping tab header registers a clickable alias by label, and a synth click on it, on the first or the second wrapped row, selects that tab.

### test_text_create_model.das

Pure-logic coverage for the creation registry: built-ins, last-wins user overrides, predicate gating, context facts, and the transform shapes.

- `test_create_builtins_present` - the creation registry ships the built-in Markdown and daslang sets, md.bold as a wrap and das.if bound to daslang buffers
- `test_create_last_wins_override` - a user creation_define under a built-in id replaces the built-in, so the overridden body is what executes
- `test_create_predicate_lambda` - a creatable's can_create predicate hides and refuses it on a non-blank line and admits it on a blank one, where the inserted rule keeps a blank line above it
- `test_create_separator_keeps_blank_neighbors` - a list or image created on the only blank line between paragraphs re-opens blank lines on both sides, and one undo reverts the whole transform
- `test_create_context_facts` - the creation context reports heading level, list prefix, code-fence membership including both marker lines, statement start and line-comment position, and the fence gates the Markdown set
- `test_create_heading_cycle` - md.heading cycles a line one level deeper per call as one undo unit each, and wraps from level 6 back to plain
- `test_create_list_and_checkbox_transforms` - list transforms renumber an ordered list over the selection and keep it selected, swap ordered markers for dashes, and the checkbox transform adds a box then flips it by the first line's state
- `test_create_quote_and_noop` - md.quote toggles the quote prefix on and off, carrying the caret by the prefix width
- `test_create_wrap_degenerate_and_snippet` - a wrap with no selection inserts both delimiters with the caret between them, and a snippet creatable inserts its template and arms a snippet session
- `test_create_das_statement_gate` - das.if declines mid-expression and at a statement start inserts the block at the line's indent, with the line's tail after the body and the condition stop armed

### test_text_edit.das

- `test_text_edit_keystrokes_reach_buffer` - real keystrokes in the live editor land in its buffer: PageDown and End move the caret, typed text marks it dirty, Enter splits the line and Backspace at column zero joins it back
- `test_text_edit_numpad_and_overtype` - numpad PageUp and Home navigate like the dedicated keys, Insert toggles overtype so a typed character replaces without growing the buffer, and Ctrl+Right, Shift+End and Ctrl+Shift+Down move and extend by their own bindings
- `test_text_edit_find_replace` - Ctrl+H seeds find from the selected word and focuses replace, Enter replaces the current match, Ctrl+Alt+Enter the rest in one undo unit, and Ctrl+G jumps to a line:col and hands the keyboard back

### test_text_edit_complete_model.das

Pure-logic coverage for the completion carrier + document-words provider.

- `test_complete_document_words_ghost` - the most frequent document word for the prefix before the caret becomes the ghost with runners-up listed, Tab accepts it instead of indenting, and moving the caret clears it
- `test_complete_keywords_and_kill_switch` - the language profile's keywords complete like document words, and a plain-text buffer never shows a ghost
- `test_complete_list_flow` - the completion list opens only after the idle delay with keyboard focus left in the editor, Down and Up walk into and out of it, and Enter accepts only a selected row and closes the list
- `test_complete_navigation_stays_silent` - moving the caret into a word or past a dot offers neither a ghost nor a list, even after the idle delay, while typing still offers
- `test_complete_escape_dismissal_sticks` - Escape keeps the completion list closed across later syncs of the same request, and only the next typed request may reopen it
- `test_complete_explicit_dot_trigger` - typing a dot opens the list at once with every document word, accepting inserts the whole word for the empty prefix, and Escape closes it
- `test_das_provider_compiles_symbols` - the daslang provider's worker compiles the buffer and offers every function and global matching the prefix, refreshing the ghost
- `test_das_issue_parsing` - compiler output parses into findings with 0-based lines, already 0-based columns, a caret-width range end or unknown width, the message, and a path only for findings in another file
- `test_das_provider_reports_diagnostics` - an idle daslang buffer compiles in the background: a broken one reports failed with pathless findings, and once fixed (as gen2 with no options) it reports ok and the findings clear
- `test_multiline_diagnostic_spans` - a multi-line finding underlines from its start column, whole middle rows and up to its end column and nothing outside, an unknown width underlines to the word end, and a foreign file's finding draws nothing
- `test_complete_statement_start_prefers_keywords` - the same prefix ranks keywords first at a statement start and document words first mid-expression
- `test_complete_rank_tiers` - completion ranks compiled symbols over document words over keywords whatever order they arrive in, the ghost takes the best, and a duplicate at a better tier is promoted without duplicating
- `test_clang_output_parsing` - clang errors and warnings parse into 0-based findings sized by caret and tildes, pathless for the checked buffer and with the path kept for a header
- `test_clang_output_parsing_posix_and_fatal` - clang output with POSIX paths parses, a fatal missing-include error is a finding sized by its caret run, and a foreign POSIX path keeps its path and line
- `test_cpp_check_argv_selects_language` - the C++ check is a syntax-only clang run that picks the C or C++ language and scratch suffix from the buffer, and an empty or unrunnable compiler is never available
- `test_cpp_provider_reports_diagnostics` - with clang present a broken C++ buffer reports failed with a pathless finding on the bad line, and a clean buffer reports ok and clears the findings
- `test_cpp_provider_c_buffer_uses_c_dialect` - a C buffer is checked as C, so code legal only in C reports ok with no findings
- `test_das_provider_drops_stale_results` - a compile that finishes after the buffer has moved on is dropped, reporting no status and underlining nothing on the newer content
- `test_complete_list_survives_keywordless_prefix` - an empty keyword offer leaves the open list showing the narrowed candidates, and only a prefix nothing matches closes it and clears the ghost
- `test_complete_offer_token_contract` - an async offer under a stale request token is dropped whole, while one under the live token appends and refreshes the ghost

### test_text_edit_model.das

Pure-logic coverage for the E1 editing core: no UI, no live host.

- `test_edit_load_and_source_round_trip` - loading detects the CRLF or LF flavor and splits lines with a trailing empty line, and the source round-trips byte-exact and clean, the empty source included
- `test_edit_insert_and_line_splits` - inserting text marks the buffer dirty and advances the revision, a newline splits the line at the caret, and a multi-line insert joins its ends to the split halves with the caret after the last segment
- `test_edit_backspace_delete_and_joins` - backspace at column zero and delete at line end join lines keeping both halves, each removes one character otherwise, and both are no-ops at the buffer edges
- `test_edit_utf8_grapheme_movement` - left, right and backspace step over whole UTF-8 graphemes of 1 to 4 bytes, a combining-mark cluster included
- `test_edit_vertical_preferred_column` - vertical moves clamp to a short line but restore the preferred column after it, and up or down past the buffer edge goes to the line start or end
- `test_edit_selection_core` - a selection reports its multi-line text in order even when made backwards, plain left and right collapse it to its start and end, and select-all and clear cover and drop it
- `test_edit_selection_edits` - with a selection active, insert replaces it and backspace or delete removes exactly the selection
- `test_edit_shift_movement` - shifted movement extends and shrinks the selection by graphemes, to line end and across lines, collapses when the caret returns to the anchor, and set_cursor clears it
- `test_edit_word_motion` - word-left stops at word starts and word-right at word ends, skipping a lone separator but stopping on a separator run, and word-left at column zero wraps to the previous line's end
- `test_edit_word_delete` - delete-word-left removes the word and keeps the space before it, a run of two or more spaces deletes on its own, and delete-word-right eats the space and word or joins at line end
- `test_edit_smart_home` - Home goes to the first non-blank and toggles between it and column zero on repeat
- `test_undo_typing_coalesces` - a typing run is one undo unit that undo reverts whole and redo restores with its after-cursor
- `test_undo_word_sized_units` - typing undoes in word-sized units broken before each space, and a new edit clears the redo stack
- `test_undo_breaks_on_kind_and_adjacency` - an undo unit breaks when the edit kind changes or the caret jumps, so the first undo reverts only the last unit
- `test_undo_backspace_run_and_joins` - a backspace run coalesces into one undo unit, and undoing a line join restores the newline and the pre-join caret line
- `test_undo_enter_fence_and_selection_restore` - Enter fences off the run before it and undoes together with the typing after it, and undoing a replaced selection restores both the text and the selection
- `test_undo_push_stop_and_word_delete` - an explicit fence splits same-kind typing into two undo units, and word deletes never coalesce, each undoing alone
- `test_undo_multiline_insert` - a multi-line insert undoes cleanly back to the insert point and redoes cleanly
- `test_save_point_clears_dirty_on_undo` - mark_saved fences the typing run and makes undo or redo landing exactly on the save point clean, while any state before or after it is dirty
- `test_save_point_unreachable_after_divergence` - after undoing past the save point and editing, the save point is unreachable, so a state at the same undo depth with a different history stays dirty
- `test_save_point_at_pristine_load` - saving a pristine buffer is a no-op whose save point undo returns to clean, load resets the save point, and undoing a replace_all returns to it
- `test_clipboard_selection_round_trip` - copy returns and records the selected text, paste inserts it at the caret, and paste and cut are each one undo unit, undoing a cut restoring the selection
- `test_clipboard_line_mode` - with no selection copy and cut take the whole line with its newline, a line-mode paste inserts above the caret line keeping the caret column, and each is one undo unit
- `test_clipboard_external_text_is_not_line_mode` - text the editor did not copy pastes at the caret rather than as a line block
- `test_overtype_mode` - overtype replaces the next character as one coalesced undo run, falls back to insert at line end without eating the newline, and toggles off
- `test_line_operations` - move-line swaps with the neighbour as one undo unit (a no-op at the top), duplicate puts the caret on the lower copy, and delete-line removes the line with its newline
- `test_line_insert_indent_and_expand` - insert-above and insert-below carry indentation, block indent skips empty lines and outdent strips a tab or up to four spaces with the caret following its byte, and Ctrl+L selects then extends whole lines
- `test_tab_smart_and_scroll_verb` - Tab block-indents a multi-line or full-line selection but replaces a partial-line one, and scroll requests accumulate for the widget
- `test_vertical_moves_are_tab_visual` - vertical moves land by visual column with tabs expanded, rounding a column inside a tab to its nearer edge, for plain and shifted moves alike
- `test_edit_goto_line` - goto-line takes 1-based lines and columns, clamps past the end, parses line:col and line,col queries, declines garbage without moving, and opening arms the dialog
- `test_edit_color_literals` - a color literal scans only as 6 or 8 hex digits at identifier boundaries, 6 digits parse opaque and 8 carry alpha, and both round-trip
- `test_edit_join_lines` - join-lines collapses the seam to one space with the caret at it, a selection joins all its lines in one undo unit, and an empty next line joins with no stray space
- `test_edit_move_selection_to` - dragging a selection moves it whole and keeps it selected as one undo unit, adjusting a target on or past its own lines for the removal, and a drop inside the selection declines
- `test_edit_byte_mapping` - byte offsets and positions map both ways over LF-joined text whatever the line flavor, ranges map by byte across newlines, and past-the-end values clamp to the buffer end
- `test_edit_replace_range_undo` - replacing a single- or multi-line range splices the text with the caret after it, and undo and redo restore and reapply it with the caret
- `test_edit_replace_all_is_one_undo_unit` - replace-all reports its count, applies back to front so earlier spans stay valid, and undoes and redoes as a single unit
- `test_edit_find_sync_flow` - find sync highlights every match and selects the current one, stepping moves the selection, replace-one rewrites only the current match and advances, replace-all undoes as one unit, and closing clears the highlights
- `test_edit_find_sync_no_replace_loop` - replace-one resumes past its own insertion, so a replacement containing the query is not matched again
- `test_edit_lexical_syntax` - the lexical tier gives every line a style entry with keyword, line-comment, string and number runs, and clearing the language drops the styles
- `test_edit_block_comment_carry` - an opened block comment carries comment style into the lines below, closing it restyles them plain, and undoing the close restyles them again
- `test_edit_auto_indent_on_enter` - Enter after an unmatched opener indents and otherwise carries the indent, a typed closer dedents in one undo unit, openers in strings and comments and Markdown never indent, and Enter between a pair splits it into three lines
- `test_edit_auto_close_pairs` - an opener auto-closes except before a word, the typed closer steps over its twin, backspace eats an empty pair, quotes pair only at word boundaries, a selection is surrounded in one undo unit, and plain text pairs nothing
- `test_edit_bracket_match` - a bracket at or just after the caret matches its partner across lines, skipping brackets in strings and respecting nesting, and an unbalanced opener reports a mismatch at its own position
- `test_edit_syntax_tracks_line_edits` - line splits and joins keep the style entries aligned with the lines, and a shifted line keeps its keyword run
- `test_edit_find_sync_regex_groups` - a regex replace-all expands group templates per match and undoes as one unit
- `test_edit_highlight_row_span_clamps` - a highlight range made stale by an edit clamps each row span to the current line length, and a row outside the buffer has no span
- `test_edit_issue_span_language_convention` - issue spans follow each language's convention - daslang 1-based lines with 0-based columns, clang 1-based both, plain 0-based columns - for single and multi-line spans
- `test_source_view_line_top_virtual_mode` - in the virtual source view a byte's line top comes from the last drawn content height, past-the-end clamps to the last row, and an undrawn view declines

### test_text_edit_snippet.das

Pure-logic coverage for the snippet engine: template parsing, one-unit undo, tab-stop navigation, edit tracking, the watchdog, key precedence.

- `test_snippet_expand_and_stops` - a snippet expands with its first placeholder selected, typing overtypes it without ending the session, and Tab past the last stop ends it at the tracked body end
- `test_snippet_wrap_keeps_selection_for_chaining` - a wrap snippet keeps the wrapped text selected so a second wrap nests around it, and each undo peels exactly one wrap
- `test_snippet_navigation` - Tab and Shift+Tab walk the snippet stops in order, Shift+Tab clamps at the first, and Tab past the last ends the session with the caret at the body end
- `test_snippet_indent_and_final_marker` - a multi-line snippet inherits the caret line's indentation on later lines, and an explicit final stop ends the session with the caret after the inner indent
- `test_snippet_one_undo_unit_and_fencing` - a snippet expansion is one undo unit that later typing never coalesces into, and redo re-applies it at the stop-1 caret without resurrecting the session
- `test_snippet_tracking_shifts_later_stops` - growing one snippet stop shifts the later stops by the growth, and a stop growing past one line ends the session cleanly
- `test_snippet_sync_watchdog` - a snippet session lives while the caret stays inside its region and ends once the caret leaves it
- `test_snippet_tab_precedence` - while a snippet session runs Tab advances its stops ahead of ghost completion and never inserts a literal tab
- `test_snippet_sessionless_and_literal_forms` - a body with no tab stops inserts with the caret at its end and no session, and a non-numeric token is emitted verbatim

### test_text_edit_syntax_model.das

Pure-logic coverage for the full-parse refinement tier.

- `test_apply_syntax_maps_and_splits` - applying parse tokens maps each role to its line style, splits a token that spans a newline into per-line runs, and records the parse revision
- `test_parse_styles_survive_same_line_edits` - parse-refined runs survive typing: an edit at the line end keeps both runs, an edit inside a run drops only that run and shifts the next, and an edit on the next line leaves this line's styles alone
- `test_syntax_sync_debounce_and_refine` - syntax sync parses only after the idle debounce, refines a function name to the function style, skips an unchanged revision, and an edit both stales the parse and restarts the debounce

### test_text_find_model.das

Pure-logic coverage for the find model: no UI, no live host.

- `test_find_literal_case_insensitive` - a case-insensitive literal find matches every spelling with the needle's span, starts current at the first match, and skips a rebuild for an identical query and revision
- `test_find_step_wraps` - stepping through matches wraps forward past the last and back past the first, and every step advances the jump revision
- `test_find_sticky_current_across_rebuild` - narrowing the query rebuilds the matches while the current match stays at the same position
- `test_find_regex_and_errors` - regex find matches every occurrence with its span, an invalid pattern yields no matches and reports an error, and zero-width matches are dropped without an error
- `test_find_reopen_rearms_jump` - reopening the find bar re-arms the jump to the kept current match, while opening with no matches or while already open arms nothing
- `test_find_replace_requests_and_open` - Ctrl+H opens both find and replace rows with focus on the replace input, replace-one and replace-all requests count, and programmatic replace text lands with widget sync armed
- `test_find_replacements_literal` - literal-mode replacement yields one replacement per match and never expands a template
- `test_find_replacements_regex_templates` - regex replacement templates expand numbered, braced and whole-match groups per match, keep a literal dollar, and expand an out-of-range group to nothing
- `test_find_replacements_named_groups` - named regex groups expand in replacement templates with each match's own captures

### test_text_flow_core.das

Headless contract tests for the shared Markdown/editor/terminal text layer. These intentionally do not create an ImGui context: layout consumes a measurement callback and emits source-mapped fragments.

- `test_text_flow_graphemes` - a combining sequence, a ZWJ emoji and a regional-indicator flag each form one grapheme cluster, and caret movement crosses each whole cluster in both directions
- `test_text_flow_terminal_cell_widths` - terminal cell widths give ASCII and a combining grapheme one cell, and CJK, ZWJ emoji, flags and emoji-presentation sequences two
- `test_text_flow_empty_source_lines_keep_byte_positions` - empty source lines each produce a visual line mapped to their newline byte, and the final empty caret line maps to the source end
- `test_text_flow_uri_fragments` - a long URI wraps greedily into several source-mapped fragments, and its copy control takes one inline slot after the URI with its identity kept and no source bytes consumed
- `test_text_flow_leading_and_trailing_controls` - leading and trailing controls become distinct fragments that keep their consumer kind and consume no source bytes, and a leading placeholder never wraps away from the first grapheme
- `test_text_flow_empty_source_control_only_span` - a control-only span over an empty source still emits its control fragment with its identity and kind, anchored at the source start and consuming no bytes
- `test_plain_text_uri_detection` - plain-text URI detection finds scheme, custom-scheme, slash-form and case-insensitive www URIs, keeps Unicode bytes, and asks a www target for a scheme prefix
- `test_text_flow_style_aware_measurement` - measurement receives each run's style id, fragments keep it, and a wider style's metrics change where lines wrap
- `test_text_flow_hit_test_grapheme_boundaries` - hit-testing a point snaps to the nearer boundary of a whole combining grapheme and reports leading affinity at an interior boundary

### test_text_fold_model.das

Fold extraction from the tree-sitter structure walk - no UI, no live host.

- `test_das_fold_extraction` - a daslang source yields one fold each for its function, struct, class and enum, the function fold spans its def line to its closing brace, and fold_at resolves bytes inside and outside it
- `test_das_folds_survive_bare_named_arguments` - a call with bare named arguments parses, so the function declared after it still folds
- `test_das_method_folds` - a class method folds as a function declaration at its own header row
- `test_markdown_fold_extraction` - a Markdown source reports a fold for its fenced code block

### test_text_hybrid.das

Live-preview (hybrid) editing scenarios for examples/text: unfold follows the caret, rich clicks place it, typing keeps the debounce, a dirty caret exit reparses immediately, and the editor state survives surface switches.

- `test_hybrid_surface_three_way` - the footer radio switches the document between the Source editor, the side-by-side split preview and the live preview
- `test_hybrid_unfold_follows_caret` - in the live preview the source island follows the caret to a new block, the block it left renders rich again, and rich runs flank the island
- `test_hybrid_click_rich_block_moves_caret` - a click on a rich block in the live preview moves the caret there and unfolds that block
- `test_hybrid_typing_debounce_and_exit_snap` - typing in a source island edits the buffer before any debounced reparse, and moving the caret out of a dirty island reparses at once
- `test_hybrid_editor_state_across_surfaces` - the live preview and Source surfaces share one buffer, undo journal and save point, and find in the preview jumps the caret and unfolds the matched block

### test_text_input_example.das

The text_input example: Unicode typing, IME, its package.

- `unicode_input_reaches_rendered_buffers_and_custom_editor_keeps_keyboard_commands` - CJK and emoji typed into a single-line field reach its rendered UTF-8 buffer byte for byte, and the custom editor keeps Backspace, which removes a whole grapheme without touching the neighbouring field
- `composition_draws_at_the_caret_and_a_click_commits_it_into_the_old_field` - an IME preedit draws its overlay and candidate rectangle at the focused field without committing, and a click on another field commits it into the field it leaves and none into the new one
- `the_overlay_marks_blocks_and_caret_in_the_field_font_inside_the_window` - the preedit overlay underlines each conversion block, thickens the focused one, places and clamps the caret inside the composition, uses the field's font, and shifts a long composition inside the window
- `a_keyboard_owner_change_cancels_and_focus_waits_for_keys_to_settle` - Tab to another field cancels the composition and commits nothing anywhere, and Escape ends editing while held but releases text-input focus only once the keys settle
- `turning_real_input_off_cancels_the_composition` - detaching real user input cancels an open composition and commits nothing into the field
- `relocated_text_input_package_starts_with_bundled_fonts` - a daspkg release of the text_input example still starts after its bundle is moved away, with its bundled fonts and licenses byte-identical to the sources

### test_text_language_model.das

Pure-logic coverage for the language profile registry: no UI, no parser.

- `test_language_lookup_canonicalizes` - a language lookup canonicalizes extensions, dotted extensions and aliases to one profile name, falls back to plain for an unknown name, and reports known only for real profiles
- `test_language_fold_kinds_migrated` - each language profile carries its own fold kinds - daslang structs, classes and block comments, C functions but no classes, C++ classes and namespaces, Markdown code fences, plain nothing
- `test_language_brackets_and_indent` - the profiles set bracket pairs, indent pairs, comment tokens and string delimiters per language: daslang indents on braces only, Markdown never indents, JSON indents in braces and brackets
- `test_language_keywords_and_completion` - daslang and C++ profiles offer their keywords, Markdown offers none, and ghost completion is on for daslang and Markdown but off for plain text
- `test_language_keywords_are_the_lexer_keywords` - every daslang profile keyword has a fallback lexer style, and the lexer styles type names as types, booleans as numbers, null as a constant and plain identifiers as nothing

### test_text_rich_das.das

Rich-das end-to-end in examples/text: comment groups render rich in the Preview surface, the caret's group unfolds to source, edits refresh only the touched fragment.

- `test_rich_das_cross_segment_click_no_jump` - in rich-das view a click on a visible line of another source segment lands the caret on that line and never scrolls
- `test_rich_das_keys_after_ctrl_end` - after Ctrl+End scrolls the caret's segment out of view, Ctrl+Home and plain arrows still reach the editor with no click
- `test_rich_das_groups_and_unfold` - source runs and rich comment groups partition the buffer, and only the comment group holding the caret renders as source
- `test_rich_das_edit_refreshes_one_fragment` - typing in an unfolded comment group makes the debounced resync reparse exactly one fragment, and code lines with trailing comments never join the groups

### test_text_source_model.das

- `test_plain_source_document` - a plain source document keeps the exact UTF-8 text and revision in one unstyled span covering every byte, an empty one has no spans, and dispose releases its line numbers
- `test_markdown_source_markers_preserve_original_bytes` - a Markdown source document marks every delimiter in source order as a bold marker span, with spans contiguous over every original byte
- `test_markdown_source_escaped_marker_stays_regular` - an escaped asterisk stays regular text while the escape and the paired strikethrough delimiters are marked

### test_text_toolbar.das

Real-click coverage for the live-preview creation flows: the class the rail-driven tests missed - clicks on blank separator lines, off-glyph clicks, and TOOLBAR buttons pressed while the island editor draws (the FocusItem reclaim used to cancel their press).

- `test_toolbar_image_between_paragraphs` - a real click on the gap between two rich paragraphs lands the caret on the separator line, and the toolbar image button inserts there with the snippet session armed
- `test_toolbar_image_below_fence` - a gap click below a code fence lands the caret on the blank line after the closing fence, not on it, so the toolbar image inserts below the fence
- `test_toolbar_buttons_fire_over_reclaim` - toolbar buttons submitted before the island editor still complete their press, so +Section and a following heading cycle both apply
- `test_click_off_glyph_and_dead_strip` - a click right of a rich line's text snaps the caret to that line's end, and a click in the strip below the island's last row clamps to the nearest line
- `test_view_click_enters_editing` - a click on a paragraph in view mode enters edit mode with the caret on the clicked line
- `test_view_drag_and_checkbox_stay_viewing` - in view mode a drag selects text and a checkbox click toggles its marker, and neither enters edit mode
- `test_click_to_edit_crlf_caret` - a view click on a CRLF document enters edit mode on the clicked line, since the caret carry maps by line and column rather than byte offset
- `test_live_reload_keeps_documents` - a live reload keeps the open document, its unsaved buffer, the caret and edit mode
- `test_escape_exits_editing` - Escape with nothing to cancel leaves edit mode

### test_text_tree_sitter.das

Tree-sitter documents: lexical recovery, JSON, grammar drift.

- `test_das_fragment_recovers_lexical_syntax_after_parse_error` - after a .das parse error the fallback lexer still colors keywords, names and types, keeps keywords inside comments and strings as comments and strings, and its spans cover every byte contiguously
- `test_json_lexical_syntax_handles_diff_fragments` - a truncated JSON diff fragment colors keys, strings, numbers, booleans and null, colors the unterminated string, and its spans cover every byte contiguously
- `test_grammar_swallow_canary` - the tree-sitter grammar parses past every canary section, so each section's marker function still yields a function fold

### test_text_viewer.das

Event-driven smoke coverage for the user-facing text viewer. Deadlines are deadlock/crash guards only; every transition waits for semantic app state.

- `test_text_viewer_open_modes_and_zoom` - the text viewer opens Markdown docked, switches to a styled source view with exact marker and emoji cells, routes copy, select-all and zoom-reset chords to semantic commands, and a new document inherits zoom with ordinary window lifecycle
- `test_text_viewer_checkbox_save_reload_roundtrip` - an unedited save preserves BOM, spelling and mixed line endings byte for byte, and a checkbox click changes exactly its marker byte, keeps the control's size, and survives save and reload
- `test_text_viewer_find_both_modes` - find selects and steps through matches in rendered Markdown and exact bytes in plain source, regex find reports invalid patterns with no matches, and a .das file opens syntax-colored
- `test_text_viewer_find_scrolls_to_match` - find next scrolls a far match into the viewport in rendered Markdown, a code-fence match included, and in the wrapped source view
- `test_text_viewer_find_icons_and_reopen` - every find bar button is an icon button, and reopening find after a close re-selects the current match with the match count kept
- `test_text_viewer_folding_and_code_copy` - a find jump expands a collapsed .das fold or Markdown code block to show the match, and the code-block copy action captures the block's content
- `test_text_viewer_fold_clicks_and_no_reflow` - clicks on a code block's fold and copy icons collapse, expand and copy it, and a .das gutter chevron collapses its region with toggles reusing the cached flow instead of reflowing
- `test_text_viewer_single_scroller` - the content child is the viewer's only scroller: in rendered and source modes, at extreme zoom and with find open, the dock window grows no scrollbar and the footer fits
- `test_text_viewer_edit_mode_save_point` - a printable keystroke in the viewer enters edit mode and lands once, save clears dirty and undo or redo across the save point toggles it, and leaving edit mode keeps the saved edit on disk
- `test_text_viewer_edit_preview_and_watch` - split editing previews the edit buffer and maps the caret into it, an external change or deletion is flagged without auto-reloading the buffer, reload refreshes it, and Done returns to the viewer

### test_text_viewer_create.das

End-to-end creation-registry scenarios in examples/text: wrap chaining, snippet Tab flow, transforms, context gating, and one REAL Ctrl+B chord.

- `test_create_wrap_chaining_and_undo` - in the live editor bold then italic wrap the selected text, the kept selection lets the wraps chain, and one undo peels exactly one wrap
- `test_create_link_snippet_tab_flow` - the link creatable arms a snippet with the url stop selected, typing replaces the placeholder, and Tab walks out of the session
- `test_create_transform_and_fence_gate` - the heading command transforms the caret line, while inside a code fence the creatable set is empty and bold declines with a status message leaving the buffer untouched
- `test_create_real_ctrl_b_chord` - a real Ctrl+B chord through the editor's key poll drives create.md.bold on the selection end to end

### test_tree.das

Tree nodes and collapsing headers: forms, open state, stacks.

- `test_tree_node_ex_smoke` - Branch, leaf, arrow-only and bullet tree_node_ex forms all register, and their tree_pop pairing renders without underflowing the stack.
- `test_tree_node_open_manual_smoke` - A closed manual tree_node_open / tree_pop pair keeps the ID stack balanced for its siblings and registers none of its body widgets.
- `test_collapsing_header_closable_smoke` - A closable collapsing_header starts open, imgui_close hides its body, and imgui_open paints the body again.

### test_visual_aids.das

Visual aids: live commands, focus rect, narrate placement.

- `test_visual_aids_dashboard_smoke` - each of the seven visual-aid live commands answers ok=true, and each toggle-style one reports enabled=false when switched off
- `test_visual_aids_focus_rect` - imgui_focus_rect toggles on and off, and a focused input exposes the non-empty bbox the focus overlay draws around
- `test_narrate_placement_smoke` - the narrate-placement grid registers its checkbox and all 20 indexed buttons, and a click on a second button counts there without firing the first again
- `test_anchor_centered_widget_picks_right` - a widget centered in a roomy viewport gets its narrate box on the right, one gap past its right edge and level with its top
- `test_anchor_right_edge_flips_to_left` - a widget near the right edge flips its narrate box to the left once the right candidate overflows the viewport
- `test_anchor_wide_widget_picks_below` - a widget too wide for either side gets its narrate box below it, horizontally centered one gap under its bottom
- `test_anchor_bottom_right_picks_above` - a wide widget at the viewport bottom gets its narrate box above it once right, left and below all fail
- `test_anchor_top_left_widget_picks_right` - a widget in the top-left corner keeps its narrate box on the right with no flip
- `test_anchor_giant_widget_falls_back_to_clamped_right` - a widget covering nearly the whole viewport falls back to the right placement clamped inside the viewport
- `test_anchor_hud_zone_pulls_right_up` - the key-HUD reserve clamps every candidate upward, and the right candidate, now clear of the target, wins the tiebreak
- `test_anchor_text_wider_than_viewport_clamps_to_margin` - a narrate box wider than the viewport falls back to an x clamped to the edge margin
- `test_floating_narrate_returns_corner` - a narrate with no target anchors at the viewport's top-left corner, one margin in
- `test_connector_start_picks_edge_facing_widget` - the connector starts at the midpoint of the narrate box edge that faces the widget, on each of the four sides
- `test_anchor_right_blocked_by_other_widget_flips_to_left` - a right candidate that overlaps a sibling widget flips the narrate box to the clear left side
- `test_anchor_all_sides_blocked_falls_back_to_clamped_right` - with a sibling blocking every side the narrate box falls back to the clamped right placement
- `test_anchor_clears_arrow_pair` - the narrate box clears both arrows of an arrow_button pair when the sibling arrow is in the hard-avoid group
- `test_anchor_clears_triple` - the narrate box clears all three controls of a row when the two siblings are in the hard-avoid group
- `test_hard_avoid_beats_incidental_crowding` - a hard-avoid sibling outweighs incidental crowding, so the box stays off the sibling even when every other side is crowded

### test_widget_path_reuse.das

- `repeated_widget_paths_do_not_allocate_strings` - Repeated widget_path_key lookups under the same container return the same full path and allocate no strings in steady state.
- `path_reuse_preserves_container_identity` - widget_path_key prefixes each container on the path stack, nested and sibling alike, and begin_frame resets an unfinished stack to the root.
- `changing_widget_ids_preserve_paths_across_cache_turnover` - Twenty thousand transient ids return exact paths while the path tables stop growing and release on rollover, and a caller-held path survives turnover and collection.
- `borrowed_widget_identifiers_are_not_retained` - A path built from borrowed caller bytes keeps its value after the caller reuses that storage, because the cache owns copies of both key components.
- `cached_dynamic_keys_survive_collection` - A path cached from heap strings stays a cache hit with the same value after its source strings are dropped and the heap is collected.

### uncategorized.das

dasImgui tests with no category file of their own yet.

- `test_set_window_size_runtime_smoke` - clicking a button that calls set_window_size resizes the window at runtime, and the size readout follows each resize
- `test_text_filter_smoke` - text_filter registers as its own kind and, with an empty filter, every log row and its sibling widgets render

### uncategorized__allow_imgui_legacy.das

- `pending_value_replaces_focused_editors` - A pending value replaces the text of a focused editor of every input_text kind, a UTF-8 and an empty replacement included, and the editor keeps its focus.
- `pending_edit_keeps_other_editor_cursor_and_undo_semantics` - A pending value posted to another editor leaves the focused editor's typed text and cursor alone, and Ctrl+Z undoes a pending replacement of the focused editor's text.
- `enter_only_result_preserves_live_text_state` - With EnterReturnsTrue every input_text kind tracks typed text and its changed flag live, and Enter returns true without counting the unchanged text as an edit.
- `duplicate_combo_rows_select_independently` - Clicking the third of three identical combo labels selects its own source index, in the plain, editable and getter forms and with a getter that skips a row.
